prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was commuting between cities a lot—one trip I remember was from Beijing to Shanghai, and it felt like half my week was spent on the move.
And on that same stretch, I also remember people talking about what was playing in Beijing at the time—movies were basically the only downtime we had.
My coworker Sun Lei had already gotten his ticket sorted for that run—train G3 on 2025-03-23, if I’m remembering the details right.
He even joked he always picked Second Class anyway, since it was comfortable enough and didn’t feel like overpaying.
Later, my friend Xu Jing told me she’d already grabbed two seats for Article 20 at CGV Xidan—the 10:00 show—so we just showed up and watched it.
